🎮 BLACK FRIDAY ALERT: Nintendo Switch 2 bundle just got WAY cheaper!

Amazon has dropped the Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle to $499 (down from $549.99) for Black Friday 2026 — the exact same price as the console sold alone. That means the $79.99 copy of Mario Kart World is essentially thrown in for free.

The bundle also includes 3 months of Nintendo Switch Online (Individual), and this matches the best price seen on the Switch 2 since its price rose to $499 back in September.

🕒 Posted: Nov 24, 2026, 08:00 (GMT+3)

📰 Sources: GamesRadar+ (live Black Friday gaming deals tracker)

👥 Follow: x.com/NintendoAmerica | x.com/GamesRadar

💬 Grabbing this Switch 2 bundle for Black Friday, or holding out for a better deal? Let us know below!
